description: This PHP class defines a log conversion plugin for the Revive Adserver, specifically handling delivery log data conversion and bucket management for openX delivery logs.

classes.name: Plugins_DeliveryLog_OxLogConversion_LogConversion
classes.description: A PHP class for handling log conversion related to openX delivery logs within the Revive Adserver plugin system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the log conversion plugin, setting type to 'raw' and calling parent constructor.

methods.name: onInstall
methods.description: Indicates no additional setup is required for installation.

methods.name: getDependencies
methods.description: Returns an array of dependencies for this plugin.

methods.name: getBucketName
methods.description: Returns the name of the bucket table used for storing log data.

methods.name: getBucketTableColumns
methods.description: Returns an array defining the columns and their types in the bucket table.

methods.name: getStatisticsName
methods.description: Returns the name of the statistics table for aggregated data.

methods.name: getStatisticsMigration
methods.description: Provides mapping details for migrating bucket data into statistics tables.

methods.name: getEarliestLoggedDataDate
methods.description: Retrieves the earliest date of logged data based on the specified date column.
